name: Machine Pullover
steps: Adjust the seat so your shoulders align with the lever pivots, then sit back and fasten the belt if fitted.
Place the backs of your elbows firmly against the arm pads and grip the handles lightly with your arms raised overhead.
Drive your elbows smoothly downward in a wide arc toward your hips by contracting your lats strongly.
Allow the lever arm to return slowly overhead until you feel a comfortable stretch through your lats and rib cage.
tips: Focus on driving through your elbows rather than pushing with your hands and triceps.
Keep your lower back against the pad and avoid letting the overhead stretch pull your ribs upward.
